lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: # VitaDeck

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: VitaDeck lets people run custom interactive deck-style interfaces on a PlayStation Vita.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Language

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Deck App**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: A user-provided interactive VitaDeck experience rendered by the VitaDeck runtime.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Plugin, applet, experience, deck

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Deck App Source Entry**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The source-level React entry file that is compiled into a **Deck App** bundle.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Plugin file, component file

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Deck App Component**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The default-exported React component from a **Deck App Source Entry**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Render function, bootstrap

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Deck App Manifest**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The metadata file that identifies a **Deck App** and its **Deck App Source Entry**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Package file, plugin config

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Deck App Package Manifest**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The metadata file inside a **Deck App Package Directory** that VitaDeck reads before loading the package, including a **Deck App Package Schema Version**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Source manifest, npm package metadata, config file

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Deck App Package Schema Version**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The manifest field that versions the **Deck App Package Manifest** shape read by VitaDeck.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: App release version, package version, semver

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Deck App Package Version**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The user-visible semver of a **Deck App Package**, stored in `manifest.json` as `version` for display and updates.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Schema version, SDK version, VitaDeck version

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Deck App Package**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The built portable unit produced from a **Deck App** project and consumed by VitaDeck.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Full runtime bundle, plugin package, upload blob

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Deck App Package Directory**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The unpacked directory form of a **Deck App Package** used by VitaDeck during local development and native packaging.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Archive, bundle folder, dist folder

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Deck App Package Name**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The SDK-generated filesystem-safe name for a **Deck App Package Directory**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Output directory, package path, app title

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Deck App Package Entry**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The generated JavaScript file inside a **Deck App Package** that registers the compiled **Deck App Component** with VitaDeck.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: User entry, source entry, main runtime

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: **Deck App Font**:

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: A named font file included in a **Deck App Package** and declared by the **Deck App Package Manifest** for author code to reference.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: _Avoid_: Raw font path, system font, hardcoded font

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: **Deck App Image**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: A named image file included in a **Deck App Package** and declared by the **Deck App Package Manifest** for author code to reference.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: _Avoid_: Raw image path, texture path, sprite sheet path

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: **Runtime Default Font**:

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: The VitaDeck-provided sans-serif font used for text when a **Deck App** does not request a **Deck App Font** or explicitly requests the reserved default font name.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: _Avoid_: Built-in Raylib font, implicit app font, serif default

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: **Font Size**:

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: The pixel height requested by **Deck App** author code for text rendering.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: _Avoid_: Text scale, named text size, point size

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Package Registration Hook**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The internal global convention used by generated **Deck App Package Entries** to hand their compiled component to the **VitaDeck Runtime Bundle**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Public SDK API, security boundary, author API

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Active Deck App**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The **Deck App Package** currently selected to run in VitaDeck.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Current plugin, selected component

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Installed Deck App Library**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The on-device collection of **Deck App Packages** available for activation, persisted across VitaDeck restarts until **Installed Deck App Removal**. Packages installed via **Runtime Upload** live here after a successful publish, not only in transient **Runtime Upload Staging**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Upload cache, package folder, app store

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **VitaDeck Shell**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The VitaDeck-owned management UI for choosing and managing installed **Deck App Packages**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Deck App menu, overlay app, launcher screen

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Shell Face Input**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: VitaDeck **System Input** face-button conventions for the **VitaDeck Shell**: Cross confirms the focused control; Circle backs out (cancels a pending **Installed Deck App Removal**, otherwise hides the **VitaDeck Shell** to the **Active Deck App**).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Deck App **Press**, mouse click, tap

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Shell Home Screen**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The default **VitaDeck Shell** view for browsing the **Installed Deck App Library**, performing **Installed Deck App Removal**, and opening **Runtime Upload** through the primary **Shell Upload Entry** action. Library entries are ordered alphabetically by the **`name`** field in each **Deck App Package Manifest** (case-insensitive), with **Deck App Package Name** as the tie-breaker when **`name`** values collide.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Live Area, system settings, account screen

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Shell Upload Entry**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The Upload row at the end of the **Shell Home Screen** list. Confirming it starts the **Runtime Upload Listener** and turns the row into the **Shell Upload Screen**; confirming it again is **Shell Upload Cancel**. It uses the same **Shell Face Input** focus-and-confirm pattern as other Shell rows; not relegated to a submenu, long-press, or **Deck App** UI.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Hidden gesture, Deck App **Press**, browser bookmark

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Shell Upload Screen**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The running state of the **Shell Upload Entry**: while the **Runtime Upload Listener** runs, the Upload row on the **Shell Home Screen** shows the **Runtime Upload URL**. It is not a separate view; the rest of the **Shell Home Screen** stays usable. When every port in the fallback range is in use, the listener does not start, the Shell shows the bind error as a message with no URL, and confirming the row again retries. It lasts until **Shell Upload Cancel**; successful and failed publishes leave it running.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Deck App screen, FTP client, OS browser chrome

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Shell Upload Cancel**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Confirming the **Shell Upload Entry** while the **Runtime Upload Listener** runs: it stops the listener without closing the **VitaDeck Shell**. It is the same confirm input on every platform (Cross, or Enter on the host).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Browser back, global back gesture, undo upload

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Installed Deck App Removal**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Deleting a **Deck App Package** from the **Installed Deck App Library** using the **VitaDeck Shell**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Uninstalling VitaDeck, clearing cache, revoking permissions

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **System Input**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: A VitaDeck-reserved input that controls VitaDeck itself instead of the running **Deck App**. The System Inputs are **Start Input** and Select, which is reserved and does nothing yet.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: App shortcut, global hotkey, hidden button

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Start Input**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The Vita `Start` **System Input** that toggles between the **Deck App** and **VitaDeck Shell**. It only hides the Shell when there is an **Active Deck App**, and it does not stop a running **Runtime Upload Listener**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Game menu, global pause, app back button

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Host Start Mapping**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The desktop host keyboard key that maps to the Vita `Start` **System Input** (F1).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Escape, window manager shortcuts, in-app hotkeys

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Host Shell Confirm Mapping**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The desktop host keyboard key that maps to Cross confirm in **Shell Face Input** while the **VitaDeck Shell** is open (Enter).

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: _Avoid_: Mouse click, Deck App **Press**, confirming a **Text Input** edit

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: **Host Pad Button Mapping**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The desktop host keyboard keys that map to the **Pad Buttons** while a **Deck App** runs and no **Text Input** edit does: Circle Backspace, Triangle T, Square S, L L, R R (see Host mappings).

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: _Avoid_: Keybinding, hotkey, shortcut

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Host Shell Back Mapping**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The desktop host keyboard key that maps to Circle back in **Shell Face Input** while the **VitaDeck Shell** is open (Backspace).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Browser back, undo typing in **Deck Apps**, delete file shortcuts

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Runtime Upload Listener**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The VitaDeck-owned HTTP server that serves the **Runtime Upload Web UI** and receives **Runtime Upload Archive** uploads. VitaDeck starts it when the user opens **Runtime Upload** from **Shell Home Screen** and binding succeeds. It binds on all network interfaces so LAN clients can reach it, uses a default TCP listen port with consecutive port fallback when that port is already in use (initially default **8787**, trying up to **10** ports), and the **Shell Upload Screen** shows the **Runtime Upload URL** for the address and port actually bound; the listener keeps running after successful and failed publishes, while the **VitaDeck Shell** is hidden, and across changes of the **Active Deck App**. VitaDeck stops it only on **Shell Upload Cancel** or when VitaDeck exits. If no port in that range can be bound, the listener does not run and the Shell shows the bind error instead.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Public API, always-on LAN service independent of the shell, background upload daemon

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Runtime Upload Web UI**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The LAN web page served by the **Runtime Upload Listener** for picking and uploading a **Runtime Upload Archive**, showing the JSON success or failure result in the browser.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Deck App UI, store frontend, CDN-hosted site

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Runtime Upload HTTP Contract**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The **Runtime Upload Listener** author-facing HTTP surface is **`GET /`** for the **Runtime Upload Web UI** plus whatever same-origin static assets that page requires, and **`POST /upload`** for **Runtime Upload POST**. Undocumented paths respond **404**; non-**POST** requests to **`/upload`** respond **405**. There is no separate health, readiness, or version HTTP endpoint in the initial **Runtime Upload** iteration.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Public REST catalog, mandatory OpenAPI, extension plugin routes

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Runtime Upload URL**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The `http://IP:PORT/` address of the **Runtime Upload Web UI** shown on the **Shell Upload Screen** when the **Runtime Upload Listener** has successfully bound, using a LAN-reachable **IP** for the device and the **PORT** actually bound.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: FTP URL, deep link, marketplace URL

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Runtime Upload POST**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The HTTP `POST /upload` endpoint on the **Runtime Upload Listener** that ingests a **Runtime Upload Archive** as either `multipart/form-data` (browser-primary) or `application/zip` (automation-friendly). For `multipart/form-data`, the file part field name is **`archive`** (single file part per request). Responses are always JSON (`Content-Type: application/json`): on success, `ok: true` plus **`packageName`** (**Deck App Package Name**) and **`version`** (**Deck App Package Version**); on failure, `ok: false` plus a short machine **`code`** and human **`message`**. Typical HTTP statuses include **200** success, **413** over **Runtime Upload Limits**, **400** malformed request body, **415** unsupported `Content-Type`, **422** archive layout or manifest validation failure, and **409** when **Runtime Upload Single-Flight** rejects a concurrent ingest.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: GraphQL mutation, WebSocket upload, chunked multi-file APIs

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Runtime Upload Single-Flight**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: At most one **Runtime Upload** ingest pipeline (from accepting **Runtime Upload POST** through **Runtime Upload Staging** validation to publish or failure) runs at a time; another **Runtime Upload POST** while one is in progress receives **HTTP 409** and JSON failure, with no upload queue.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Parallel unpack, pipelined installs, last-wins overwrite

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Upload Pairing**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: A future optional ephemeral credential that authorizes clients to use a **Runtime Upload Listener**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Login, account, DRM

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Runtime Upload Limits**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: VitaDeck-enforced caps on **Runtime Upload Archive** size, unpacked size, and entry count to prevent zip-style abuse (initially 16MB uploaded, 64MB unpacked, 256 entries).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: User quota, app permissions, download budget

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Runtime Upload Staging**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: A temporary on-disk location where **Runtime Upload** unpacks and validates a **Runtime Upload Archive** before it becomes visible in the **Installed Deck App Library**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Cache, download folder, build output

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Runtime Upload Replacement**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: A **Runtime Upload** that overwrites an existing **Installed Deck App** because the uploaded `.vdapp` **Deck App Package Name** matches.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Uninstall, rollback, package rename

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Deck App Runtime Restart**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Restarting the Deck App JavaScript runtime with a fresh context after **Runtime Upload Replacement** of the **Active Deck App** or after changing the **Active Deck App**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Hot reload, refresh, soft reload

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: **Deck App Failure Screen**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The VitaDeck-painted screen that replaces the **Active Deck App** after it throws an uncaught error (during boot, render, effects, input handlers, or timers), showing the error message, the first lines of its stack, and that **Start Input** opens the **VitaDeck Shell**. A **Deck App Runtime Restart** clears it. A promise rejection that still has no handler once pending promise callbacks have run counts as an uncaught error, so a `fetch` chain without a `catch` fails the Deck App instead of failing silently.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: _Avoid_: Crash screen, red box, blank screen

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Runtime Upload Archive**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: A zip file that unpacks to exactly one top-level **Deck App Package Directory** whose name ends in `.vdapp`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Source zip, VPK, npm tarball

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Deck App Workspace**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The in-repository JavaScript workspace containing the **VitaDeck SDK**, VitaDeck runtime project, and example Deck App projects.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Plugin folder, examples folder

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Runtime Upload**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The installation flow where a **Runtime Upload Archive** is uploaded through the **Runtime Upload Web UI** (or compatible HTTP clients) while the **Runtime Upload Listener** is running (started from the **Shell Upload Entry**; see **Runtime Upload Listener**). Successful publishes add or replace entries in the persistent **Installed Deck App Library** like other installed packages.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Hot reload, live edit

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Render Surface**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The full Vita display area owned by the currently running **Deck App**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Page, route, viewport

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **VitaDeck Runtime API**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The public author-facing API used by **Deck Apps** to render UI and access VitaDeck capabilities.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Native bindings, intrinsic elements, host config

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **VitaDeck Runtime Bundle**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The VitaDeck-owned JavaScript bundle that bootstraps the runtime and loads the selected **Deck App Package**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: App bundle, package entry, main app

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Runtime Dependency**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: A JavaScript dependency provided by the **VitaDeck Runtime Bundle** rather than bundled into a **Deck App Package**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: App dependency, bundled dependency, peer package

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **VitaDeck SDK**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The npm package that provides the **VitaDeck Runtime API** and Deck App build tooling, distributed on the public npm registry as `@vitadeck/sdk` so **Deck App** projects can live outside the **Deck App Workspace**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Runtime package, CLI package, app framework

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Deck App Project Scaffold**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The SDK-generated starting project layout for authoring one standalone **Deck App**. Outside the **Deck App Workspace**, the scaffold pins `@vitadeck/sdk` with a **caret range** anchored to the **VitaDeck SDK** version that produced the scaffold.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Example copy, starter blob, template folder

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Runtime Theme**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The VitaDeck-provided styling palette available to **Deck Apps** through the **VitaDeck Runtime API**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Sample theme, app-local theme

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Screen**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The root **VitaDeck Runtime API** component representing the full Vita display.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Surface, viewport, canvas

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Button**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The **VitaDeck Runtime API** component that receives **Press** input.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Pressable rect, clickable shape

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: **Image**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: A visual-only **VitaDeck Runtime API** component for drawing a **Deck App Image**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: _Avoid_: Texture, sprite, bitmap widget

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: **Stack**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The **VitaDeck Runtime API** component that places its children one after another in a column or a row, with gap, padding and cross-axis alignment, sized to its content unless given a size. `Scroll` is a column Stack whose content scrolls inside a fixed viewport.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: _Avoid_: Flexbox, flex container, layout box, list

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Press**:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The VitaDeck input gesture used by public **Button** callbacks.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: _Avoid_: Click, mouse down, mouse up, hover

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: **Focus**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The one **Deck App** control, if any, that the D-pad moves between and Cross presses. **Button** and **Text Input** take Focus.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: _Avoid_: Selection, hover, highlight, active element

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: **Pad Button**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: A Vita button a **Deck App** listens to directly through `usePadButton`: Circle, Triangle, Square, L or R. The D-pad and Cross drive **Focus** instead, and Start and Select are **System Input**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: _Avoid_: Hotkey, shortcut, raw button, gamepad event

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: **Text Input**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The **VitaDeck Runtime API** component (`TextInput`) for entering one line of text. A **Press** on it starts an edit, in the Vita's system keyboard dialog or in place on the desktop host, and confirming the edit reports the new text once.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: _Avoid_: Text field, text box, IME, keyboard input

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: **Host Control**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The VitaDeck capability for a **Deck App** to ask a nearby computer on the LAN to run a typed command through the **Host Companion**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: _Avoid_: Remote desktop, PC control, Runtime Upload

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: **Host Companion**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The program on a nearby Mac or Windows computer that performs **Host Control Link** and executes **Host Control** commands. It is not the desktop build of VitaDeck, even when both run on one machine during development.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: _Avoid_: Host Control Companion, desktop app, daemon, host build

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: **Host Control Link**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The step where the **Host Companion**, given the address shown in the **VitaDeck Shell**, tells VitaDeck where to send **Host Control** commands. VitaDeck keeps that address until a newer link replaces it or the user forgets it. It exchanges addresses, not credentials.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: _Avoid_: Pairing, Upload Pairing, session, typing the computer's address on the Vita

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: **Deck App Storage**:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The string key-value store a **Deck App** keeps across **Deck App Runtime Restarts** and VitaDeck restarts, through `storage` in the **VitaDeck Runtime API**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: _Avoid_: localStorage, save file, cache, settings

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Relationships

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - A **Deck App** is rendered by the VitaDeck runtime.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - A **Deck App** is authored against the **VitaDeck Runtime API**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The **VitaDeck Runtime API** `fetch` rejects a response whose body exceeds 4 MiB.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - A **Deck App** owns the full **Render Surface** in the MVP.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - A **Deck App Source Entry** is bundled at build time for the MVP.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - A **Deck App Source Entry** default-exports one **Deck App Component**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - A **Deck App Manifest** (`vitadeck.config.json`) contains `name`, `entry`, and `outDir`, plus optional `version`, `fonts`, and `images`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - A **Deck App Manifest** selects which **Deck App Source Entry** is bundled.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - A **Deck App Package Manifest** includes `schemaVersion` (**Deck App Package Schema Version**), `version` (**Deck App Package Version**), package display name, and package entry path.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - A **Deck App Package** contains compiled **Deck App** code and metadata, but not the VitaDeck runtime.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - A **Deck App Package Directory** is the initial on-disk artifact format for a **Deck App Package**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - A **Deck App Package Directory** always uses a `.vdapp` suffix.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - A **Deck App Package Name** is generated by the **VitaDeck SDK**, typically from Deck App metadata.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - A **Deck App Package Entry** is generated by the **VitaDeck SDK** from a **Deck App Source Entry**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - A **Deck App Package Entry** uses the **Package Registration Hook** generated by the **VitaDeck SDK**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **Package Registration Hook** is an internal compatibility convention, not a security boundary.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - A **Deck App Font** is stored inside a **Deck App Package** and declared by the **Deck App Package Manifest**.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - **Deck Apps** reference **Deck App Fonts** by declared name rather than by filesystem path.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - **Deck App Font** references in author code are flat names, not font style objects.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Text uses the **Runtime Default Font** when no font is requested or when the reserved default font name is requested.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - **Font Size** is expressed as raw pixels in the **VitaDeck Runtime API**.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - **Deck App Font** names cannot use VitaDeck-reserved font names.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - The **VitaDeck SDK** copies declared **Deck App Fonts** into the built **Deck App Package Directory**.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - A **Deck App Package** is invalid when a declared **Deck App Font** is missing or uses an unsupported font file format.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - VitaDeck loads declared **Deck App Fonts** when a **Deck App Package** starts, before rendering the **Deck App**.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - A loaded **Deck App Font** may render at any requested **Font Size**; packages do not declare a fixed list of font sizes.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - A **Deck App Image** is stored inside a **Deck App Package** and declared by the **Deck App Package Manifest**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - **Deck Apps** reference **Deck App Images** by declared name rather than by filesystem path.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The **VitaDeck SDK** copies declared **Deck App Images** into the built **Deck App Package Directory**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - A **Deck App Package** is invalid when a declared **Deck App Image** is missing or uses an unsupported image file format.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - VitaDeck loads declared **Deck App Images** when a **Deck App Package** starts, before rendering the **Deck App**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - **Image** is a visual-only component; it receives neither **Press** nor scroll input.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - A **Stack** lays out **Button**, **Text Input**, **Image**, Rect and nested **Stack** children; Text and `Scroll` children keep their own `x`/`y`. A laid-out child's coordinate along the flow is a margin before it, the other an offset from its aligned position.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - A **Stack** is visual-only like **Image**; D-pad **Focus** navigation and hit testing use the positions it computes.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `Scroll` lays out its children exactly like a column **Stack** and adds scroll input on top.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Deck App authors export a **Deck App Component**; they do not call VitaDeck registration APIs directly.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - A **Deck App Source Entry** may use normal TypeScript and ES module syntax; the **VitaDeck SDK** compiles it into the **Deck App Package Entry**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Runtime Upload** transports a **Deck App Package Directory** as a **Runtime Upload Archive** without changing the package contents.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - A **Runtime Upload Archive** contains exactly one top-level `.vdapp` directory and no other top-level entries.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The **Active Deck App** is chosen in the **VitaDeck Shell** and persists across VitaDeck restarts; when none is set, VitaDeck activates the first **Installed Deck App Library** entry at startup, or the package from the first successful **Runtime Upload** publish.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **Deck App Workspace** is a pnpm workspace rooted at `js/`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **Deck App Workspace** contains package-shaped example Deck App projects under `js/examples/`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **Deck App Workspace** contains the local **VitaDeck SDK** package under `js/packages/sdk/`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **Deck App Workspace** contains the VitaDeck-owned runtime package under `js/packages/runtime/`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - VitaDeck owns bootstrapping and renders the **Deck App Component**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - React is a **Runtime Dependency** owned by the **VitaDeck Runtime Bundle**, not bundled into **Deck App Packages**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **VitaDeck SDK** must make the compatible React version explicit for Deck App development.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **VitaDeck SDK** declares React compatibility through peer dependencies.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **VitaDeck SDK** build validates that a Deck App project resolves a compatible React version.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **VitaDeck SDK** provides a TypeScript config preset for Deck App projects.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **VitaDeck SDK** provides a **Deck App Project Scaffold** for creating package-shaped Deck App projects.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - A **Deck App Project Scaffold** created outside the **Deck App Workspace** declares `@vitadeck/sdk` as `^version` matching the scaffolding **VitaDeck SDK** release.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - A **Deck App Project Scaffold** is author-facing and is not a repo migration tool.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **VitaDeck Runtime API** may be implemented as a thin local TypeScript module for the MVP.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **VitaDeck SDK** is imported by Deck App projects as `@vitadeck/sdk`, resolved from the npm registry in standalone projects and via the **Deck App Workspace** during VitaDeck development.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The published **VitaDeck SDK** is consumed like a typical npm library: compiled JavaScript for runtime imports and declaration files for TypeScript.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **VitaDeck SDK** exposes the **VitaDeck Runtime API** and produces **Deck App Package Directories**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **VitaDeck SDK** emits a **Runtime Upload Archive** alongside each built **Deck App Package Directory** by default; a build may omit the archive when the author only needs the directory.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **VitaDeck SDK** writes **`Deck App Package Version`** into the **Deck App Package Manifest** using the Deck App project's `package.json` `version` by default.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - An optional `version` in `vitadeck.config.json` overrides `package.json` for **`Deck App Package Version`**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **VitaDeck Runtime Bundle** is preferably named `runtime.js` to distinguish it from **Deck App Package Entries**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **VitaDeck Runtime API** provides the **Runtime Theme**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Deck Apps** consume the **Runtime Theme**; VitaDeck owns the theme provider.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - VitaDeck-owned native bridge entry points used to drive rendering and input are not part of the **VitaDeck Runtime API**; **Deck App** source is not written against them.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **Screen** component is the root of a **Deck App** UI.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - A **Deck App Component** explicitly renders **Screen**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - **Button** and **Text Input** are the only public components that receive **Press** input. `Scroll` is the only public component that takes scroll input (touch drag, analog stick, mouse wheel); it does not receive **Press**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Button** exposes press-oriented callbacks: `onPress`, `onPressStart`, and `onPressEnd`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - **Button** exposes **Focus** callbacks `onFocus` and `onBlur`; `focusColor` fills it while it has **Focus**, and `autoFocus` gives it **Focus** on mount, the last mounted one winning.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - At most one control has **Focus**. The D-pad moves it spatially and Cross presses it; a touch press presses directly and clears it.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - On the desktop host, mouse hover moves **Focus** to the hovered **Button**, and a mouse press focuses the **Button** it presses, so focus styling can be tested without a gamepad. Moving the pointer to empty space keeps **Focus**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - **Pad Buttons** reach a **Deck App** only through `usePadButton` and only while the **VitaDeck Shell** is hidden; one held when the Shell hides is ignored until released.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Circle is a **Pad Button** in a **Deck App** and back in the **VitaDeck Shell**; on the desktop host both are Backspace.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - A **Text Input** is controlled: `onChange` fires once with the final text when the user confirms an edit, on the Vita and the desktop host alike; a cancelled edit fires nothing.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - On the Vita a **Text Input** edit opens the system keyboard dialog, pre-filled with `value` and titled with `placeholder`; on the desktop host the field edits in place (see Host mappings).

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - While a **Text Input** edit runs, no other **Deck App** input is delivered; opening the **VitaDeck Shell** cancels the edit.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - **Runtime Upload** uses a **Runtime Upload Listener** on the Vita and on the desktop host.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The **Runtime Upload Listener** starts when the user confirms the **Shell Upload Entry** and runs until **Shell Upload Cancel** or VitaDeck exits, including while the shell is hidden.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **Runtime Upload Listener** listens on all interfaces with default port **8787** and falls forward to following ports until one binds or **10** attempts fail; the **Runtime Upload URL** reflects the bound port when binding succeeds.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - If all **10** listen attempts fail, the Shell shows the bind error (no **Runtime Upload URL**, no **Runtime Upload Web UI**); confirming the **Shell Upload Entry** again retries.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Runtime Upload** primary author interaction is the **Runtime Upload Web UI** served locally by the **Runtime Upload Listener**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **Runtime Upload HTTP Contract** limits documented listener behavior to **`GET /`** (and required same-origin Web UI assets) and **`POST /upload`**; other paths **404**, wrong method on **`/upload`** **405**; no **GET /health**-style probe in the initial **Runtime Upload** iteration.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Initial **Runtime Upload** trusts the local network; **Upload Pairing** is optional future hardening.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Runtime Upload** accepts exactly one **Runtime Upload Archive** per request via **Runtime Upload POST**, using `multipart/form-data` for browsers (file field **`archive`**) and `application/zip` for simple HTTP clients.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Runtime Upload POST** returns JSON only: success includes **`packageName`** and **`version`**; failures include **`code`** and **`message`**, with HTTP status reflecting the error class.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Runtime Upload Single-Flight** applies to **Runtime Upload POST**: concurrent ingests get **409** and no queue.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Runtime Upload** enforces **Runtime Upload Limits** and rejects over-limit archives without installing anything.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Runtime Upload** validates packages in **Runtime Upload Staging** and only publishes successful installs into the **Installed Deck App Library**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - When a simple atomic rename/swap is practical, **Runtime Upload** publishes by swapping staged content into place; otherwise it keeps staging isolated until a single publish step completes.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Runtime Upload** replaces an existing **Installed Deck App** when the **Deck App Package Name** matches the uploaded `.vdapp` directory name.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Runtime Upload Replacement** is not **Installed Deck App Removal**; it overwrites package contents in place.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - When **Runtime Upload Replacement** targets the **Active Deck App**, VitaDeck performs a **Deck App Runtime Restart** immediately after a successful publish so the running session loads the new package bits.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Changing the **Active Deck App** at runtime triggers a **Deck App Runtime Restart**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - After a successful **Runtime Upload** publish, the **VitaDeck Shell** reports the installed name and version, the **Installed Deck App Library** list updates, and the **Runtime Upload Listener** keeps running so another upload can proceed; only **Shell Upload Cancel** stops it.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - After a failed **Runtime Upload**, the **Runtime Upload Listener** keeps running so the upload can be retried.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Runtime Upload installs into the **Installed Deck App Library**; activation is a separate choice, except that the first publish becomes the **Active Deck App** when none is set.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Runtime Upload** successful publishes are **durable**: they survive VitaDeck restarts until **Installed Deck App Removal**; only **Runtime Upload Staging** is temporary.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **VitaDeck Shell** is opened through **System Input** rather than by a **Deck App**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **VitaDeck Shell** uses **Shell Face Input** conventions separate from **Deck App** **Press** semantics.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - On the desktop host, **Host Shell Confirm Mapping** and **Host Shell Back Mapping** apply only while the **VitaDeck Shell** is open.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - On the desktop host, a connected gamepad's face buttons drive **Shell Face Input** alongside the keyboard mappings.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - **Start Input** toggles between the **Deck App** and **VitaDeck Shell**; hiding the shell, by **Start Input** or back, requires an **Active Deck App**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Neither **Start Input** nor back stops the **Runtime Upload Listener**; only **Shell Upload Cancel** does.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - **Shell Upload Cancel** has no dedicated shortcut; it is the normal confirm on the **Shell Upload Entry**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The Vita `Start` button is a **System Input** reserved for VitaDeck; on the desktop host it uses the **Host Start Mapping** (F1).

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The Vita `Select` button is a **System Input** reserved for VitaDeck with no behavior and no host mapping yet; releasing it to **Deck Apps** later would not break them, while reserving it later would.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - The **Shell Home Screen** lists **Deck App Package Version** from each installed **Deck App Package Manifest**, sorted by manifest **`name`** (case-insensitive), then **Deck App Package Name** when **`name`** ties.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Runtime Upload** is offered from the **Shell Home Screen** as a primary action via **Shell Upload Entry**, not as a secondary or **Deck App**-hosted flow.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Installed Deck App Removal** cannot target the **Active Deck App**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - **Host Control** commands go from VitaDeck to the **Host Companion**; the Vita listens only during **Host Control Link**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - **Host Control Link** starts from the **VitaDeck Shell** and does not use the **Runtime Upload Listener**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - **Host Control** results use the same `ok` / `code` / `message` JSON shape as **Runtime Upload POST**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - **Host Control Link** is not **Upload Pairing**; initial **Host Control** trusts the local network like initial **Runtime Upload**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Each **Deck App Package Name** has its own **Deck App Storage**, limited to 1 MiB; a **Deck App** cannot read another's.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - **Runtime Upload Replacement** keeps the package's **Deck App Storage**; **Installed Deck App Removal** deletes it.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - **Deck App Storage** is the only filesystem a **Deck App** reaches; no **VitaDeck Runtime API** call takes a file path.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Host mappings

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Every Vita input has a desktop host equivalent, and a connected gamepad works alongside the keyboard. `src/ui/input.c` implements the **Deck App** column, `src/platform/text_input_host.c` the **Text Input** editing rows, and `src/shell/shell.c` the Shell column; change them together with this table.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | Vita | Desktop host | In a **Deck App** | In the **VitaDeck Shell** |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | D-pad | Arrow keys | Moves **Focus** | Moves between rows and actions |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | Cross | Enter | Presses the **Button** or **Text Input** with **Focus** | Confirm |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | Circle | Backspace | **Pad Button** `circle` | Back |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | Triangle | T | **Pad Button** `triangle` | |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | Square | S | **Pad Button** `square` | |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | L | L | **Pad Button** `l` | |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | R | R | **Pad Button** `r` | |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | Start | F1 | **Start Input**: opens the Shell | **Start Input**: hides the Shell |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | Select | none | Reserved **System Input** | Reserved **System Input** |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | Touch press | Mouse press | Presses the **Button** under it; touch clears **Focus**, the mouse focuses that **Button** | |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | | Mouse hover | Moves **Focus** to the hovered **Button** | |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | Touch drag, left stick | Mouse wheel | Scrolls a `Scroll`: drag and wheel the one under the pointer, the stick the one holding **Focus** | |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | Keyboard dialog keys | Typing, Backspace | While a **Text Input** edit runs: edit its text | |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | Keyboard dialog Enter | Enter | While a **Text Input** edit runs: confirms it | |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | Keyboard dialog close or cancel | Escape | While a **Text Input** edit runs: cancels it | |

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Example dialogue

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Can this React component be the whole thing VitaDeck runs?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "For MVP language, call the runnable thing a **Deck App**; a React component may be its entry point, but the Deck App is the user-facing unit."

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Can Deck Apps be installed while VitaDeck is already running?"

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Yes — **Runtime Upload** installs a **Runtime Upload Archive** over the LAN; the SDK still bundles each **Deck App Source Entry** at build time."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Does VitaDeck keep its own navigation UI around the Deck App?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — for MVP, the running **Deck App** owns the full **Render Surface**."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should Deck App authors use raw `<vita-button>` tags?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — expose a **VitaDeck Runtime API** so the author contract can stay stable while internals evolve."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should Deck App projects typecheck against VitaDeck's native rendering calls?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — those belong to the **VitaDeck Runtime Bundle**. Authors use the **VitaDeck Runtime API**; ordinary JS conveniences the runtime provides (such as timers, a wall clock, and logging) can be typed as a narrow host layer, but native bridge entry points stay internal until VitaDeck deliberately exposes them as API."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should the npm package be called `@vitadeck/runtime`?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — use the **VitaDeck SDK** package at `@vitadeck/sdk`; it includes the Runtime API plus build tooling."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Does the VitaDeck-owned JS bundle still need to be called `main.js`?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — prefer `runtime.js` for the **VitaDeck Runtime Bundle**, though the name is a clarity choice rather than a core domain rule."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should each Deck App Package include its own React copy?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — React is a **Runtime Dependency** provided by VitaDeck, and the **VitaDeck SDK** makes the supported development version explicit."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "How do Deck App authors know which React version to use?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "The **VitaDeck SDK** declares React as a peer dependency and validates the resolved version during package builds."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should every Deck App project hand-write its TypeScript config and folder layout?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — the **VitaDeck SDK** provides a TypeScript config preset and a **Deck App Project Scaffold**."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Is the scaffold for reorganizing the VitaDeck repo?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — a **Deck App Project Scaffold** creates one standalone Deck App project for authors."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should each sample app carry its own theme helper?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — theme is a **Runtime Theme** provided by the **VitaDeck Runtime API**."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should Deck Apps mount the theme provider?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — VitaDeck provides it during bootstrap; Deck Apps only consume the **Runtime Theme**."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "What should the root UI component be called?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Use **Screen**; it represents the Vita display that the Deck App owns."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should VitaDeck wrap Deck Apps in Screen automatically?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — a **Deck App Component** explicitly renders **Screen** so display ownership is visible in author code."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Can any visual element receive clicks?"

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — **Button** and **Text Input** are the only public components that receive **Press**; `Scroll` takes scroll input but not **Press**."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should Deck Apps use mouse event names?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — public input is described as **Press**, using `onPress`, `onPressStart`, and `onPressEnd`."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should a Deck App call render itself?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — the **Deck App Source Entry** default-exports a **Deck App Component**, and VitaDeck owns rendering it."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should app authors call `vitadeck.registerDeckApp`?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — authors only default-export a **Deck App Component**; the **VitaDeck SDK** generates the **Deck App Package Entry** that registers it."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Does hiding registration behind a global prevent authors from using it?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — a global is still reachable; the **Package Registration Hook** is an internal convention and compatibility boundary, not access control."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Does the generated registration model mean authors cannot use TypeScript or ES modules?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — author code remains normal TypeScript with ES modules; only the generated **Deck App Package Entry** is shaped for VitaDeck runtime loading."

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should a Text component point straight at `fonts/body.ttf`?"

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — include the file as a **Deck App Font** and reference the declared name from author code, so package validation owns file resolution."

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should Text accept CSS-like font objects with weight and style?"

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — author code references a flat **Deck App Font** name; separate weights or styles can be separate declared font names."

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should text sizing use names like `body` or `caption`?"

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — expose **Font Size** as raw pixels; Deck Apps can define their own named constants."

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: > **Dev:** "What font does Text use when no font is specified?"

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Use the **Runtime Default Font**, a VitaDeck-provided sans-serif font, so basic Deck Apps render text without packaging a font."

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Can author code write `font=\"default\"`?"

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Yes — treat the reserved default font name the same as omitting `font`, and reject **Deck App Font** declarations that try to reuse reserved names."

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should VitaDeck ignore a missing declared font and fall back to default?"

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — a missing or unsupported declared **Deck App Font** makes the **Deck App Package** invalid, the same way a missing package entry does."

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should declared fonts be loaded lazily during render?"

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — load declared **Deck App Fonts** when the **Deck App Package** starts so rendering does not partially proceed with font errors."

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Must each Deck App declare every pixel size it will use?"

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — a loaded **Deck App Font** renders at the requested **Font Size**; size-specific font atlases are a future rendering-quality optimization."

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Do authors copy fonts into the package output by hand?"

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — authors declare **Deck App Fonts** in SDK configuration, and the **VitaDeck SDK** copies them into the built **Deck App Package Directory**."

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Does the Vita runtime need to read the manifest?"

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — the **Deck App Manifest** is build-time metadata; VitaDeck reads the **Deck App Package Manifest** the SDK generates from it."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should a `.vdapp` directory include metadata VitaDeck can read?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Yes — every **Deck App Package Directory** includes a versioned **Deck App Package Manifest** so VitaDeck can validate the package before loading code."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should the built artifact include all of VitaDeck's runtime code?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — call the artifact a **Deck App Package**; it contains the Deck App's compiled code and metadata, while VitaDeck keeps owning runtime bootstrap."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should the first package format be a zip file?"

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — start with a **Deck App Package Directory** so VitaDeck reads plain files; **Runtime Upload** uses a **Runtime Upload Archive** zip only for transport."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should `outDir` include the `.vdapp` folder name?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — `outDir` names the parent output location; the **VitaDeck SDK** generates the **Deck App Package Name** with a `.vdapp` suffix."

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: > **Dev:** "How do I choose which Deck App runs?"

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Pick it in the **VitaDeck Shell**; the **Active Deck App** persists across restarts. Desktop builds stage the example packages into the **Installed Deck App Library**."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should example Deck Apps stay under `js/deck-apps/`?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — make `js/` a pnpm **Deck App Workspace** with standalone examples under `js/examples/` and the local **VitaDeck SDK** under `js/packages/sdk/`."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "When a user makes another Deck App active at runtime, should VitaDeck hot-swap it inside the existing JavaScript context?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — changing the **Active Deck App** restarts the Deck App runtime with a fresh JavaScript context."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should uploading a Deck App automatically make it active?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — Runtime Upload installs into the **Installed Deck App Library**; activation is a separate choice."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should the management UI be rendered inside every Deck App?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — use a separate **VitaDeck Shell** opened by **System Input**, with the Vita `Start` button reserved for VitaDeck."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should the upload HTTP listener run the whole time VitaDeck is open?"

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — start the **Runtime Upload Listener** only when the user confirms the **Shell Upload Entry**, and stop it on **Shell Upload Cancel**; until then it serves any number of uploads without rebinding."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should Runtime Upload stream individual package files, or one archive?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "One **Runtime Upload Archive** zip so installs are atomic and easy to validate."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should the zip place `manifest.json` at the archive root, or inside a `.vdapp` folder?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Inside exactly one top-level `.vdapp` directory, matching the built **Deck App Package Directory** layout."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "If Runtime Upload targets an existing **Deck App Package Name**, should VitaDeck keep both copies?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — replace the installed package, and show **Deck App Package Version** from the **Deck App Package Manifest** in the **VitaDeck Shell**."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "What field name should carry **Deck App Package Version**, and should it be semver?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Use `version` in `manifest.json` as a semver string, distinct from `schemaVersion`."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Where do authors set **Deck App Package Version** during development?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Default to `package.json` `version`, with an optional override in `vitadeck.config.json` when present."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should **Runtime Upload** require an ephemeral upload token?"

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Not initially — trust the LAN while the **Runtime Upload Listener** runs; add optional **Upload Pairing** later if needed."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should **Runtime Upload** allow huge zips?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — enforce **Runtime Upload Limits** on uploaded size, unpacked size, and entry count, and reject failures without partial installs."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should installs be atomic even if it complicates the implementation?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Prefer atomic swap when it stays a small filesystem operation; otherwise still stage and validate, but avoid showing broken half-installed packages in the library."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Can users delete the **Active Deck App** from the library?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — **Installed Deck App Removal** must not target the **Active Deck App**."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Can **Runtime Upload** replace the **Active Deck App** anyway?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Yes — **Runtime Upload Replacement** overwrites in place, then restarts the Deck App runtime so the active session matches the new bits."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should that restart wait for an extra confirmation step?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — do a **Deck App Runtime Restart** immediately after a successful publish to avoid mismatched on-disk bits versus loaded code."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "After a successful upload, should the **Shell Upload Screen** stay open?"

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Yes — the updated library is visible on the same **Shell Home Screen**, and the listener keeps serving further uploads until **Shell Upload Cancel**."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "If an upload fails validation, should the Upload screen close?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — keep the **Shell Upload Screen** open so the **Runtime Upload Listener** stays available for a quick retry."

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: > **Dev:** "What desktop host key should represent Vita `Start`?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Use **Host Start Mapping** on F1."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should `Start` dismiss the **Shell Upload Screen** instantly?"

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — **Start Input** may hide the Shell, but the **Runtime Upload Listener** keeps running; only **Shell Upload Cancel** ends uploads, so they are not ended accidentally."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "What should **Shell Upload Cancel** do?"

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Stop the **Runtime Upload Listener** and keep the **VitaDeck Shell** open on the **Shell Home Screen**."

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should **Shell Upload Cancel** have its own keyboard shortcut?"

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — it is the normal confirm on the **Shell Upload Entry**, which avoids accidental listener shutdown."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should **VitaDeck Shell** controls use the same input words as **Deck App** buttons?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — **Shell Face Input** uses Cross/Circle confirm/back conventions; **Deck Apps** keep **Press** language."

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: > **Dev:** "How should **Shell Face Input** work on the desktop host with only a keyboard?"

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Use **Host Shell Confirm Mapping** on Enter and **Host Shell Back Mapping** on Backspace while the Shell is open; a connected gamepad's face buttons work too."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should **Runtime Upload** be a raw HTTP upload only?"

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — serve a **Runtime Upload Web UI** at the **Runtime Upload URL** with a file picker and the browser-side success/failure result, backed by the same **Runtime Upload Listener**."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should browser uploads use multipart zip posts?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Yes — use `multipart/form-data` as the primary **Runtime Upload POST** shape with a single file part named **`archive`**, and keep raw `application/zip` as a compatible option for scripts."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should **Runtime Upload POST** return HTML for browsers and plain text for scripts?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — JSON only for every client: **`ok`**, **`packageName`** and **`version`** on success, **`code`** and **`message`** on failure, with HTTP status for the error class."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "How should the **Runtime Upload Listener** choose host and port?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Bind on all interfaces for LAN access, start at a default port (**8787**) and try the next ports if busy (up to **10** tries), and show the real **Runtime Upload URL** on the **Shell Upload Screen**."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "What if two **Runtime Upload POST** requests overlap?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Use **Runtime Upload Single-Flight**: reject the second with **409** and JSON failure; no queue, so VitaDeck stays simple."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "If every port in the fallback range is busy, what should the **Shell Upload Screen** offer?"

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Show that the upload server could not start and omit the **Runtime Upload URL**; confirming the **Shell Upload Entry** again retries — no separate retry button."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should the **Runtime Upload Listener** expose extra HTTP APIs for scripts?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — stick to the **Runtime Upload HTTP Contract**: **`GET /`** plus assets for the **Runtime Upload Web UI** and **`POST /upload`**; **404** elsewhere, **405** on **`/upload`** if not **POST**; skip a separate health endpoint for now."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Should **Runtime Upload** be a buried Shell action?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — **Shell Upload Entry** on the **Shell Home Screen** is a primary control using normal **Shell Face Input**, same family as picking a library item."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "Are **Runtime Upload** installs session-only?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "No — after publish they are normal **Installed Deck App Library** entries on disk until removed, same durability expectation as build-time shipped packages."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Dev:** "How should the **Shell Home Screen** order installed apps?"

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: > **Domain expert:** "Alphabetical by **`name`** in **Deck App Package Manifest**, case-insensitive, with **Deck App Package Name** as a stable tie-break."

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Flagged ambiguities

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "React component" can mean either a source-level entry component or the whole runnable **Deck App**; resolved: **Deck App** is the runnable unit.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - "upload" can mean build-time packaging or **Runtime Upload**; resolved: the SDK build packages Deck Apps, while **Runtime Upload** is the on-device HTTP install flow.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "HTTP upload" could mean browser multipart or raw zip bytes; resolved: **Runtime Upload POST** supports `multipart/form-data` for browsers (field **`archive`**) and `application/zip` for automation.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "upload response" could mean HTML, plain text, or structured data; resolved: **Runtime Upload POST** always responds with JSON and uses HTTP status for error class.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "concurrent uploads" could mean parallel ingests or queued retries; resolved: **Runtime Upload Single-Flight** — one ingest at a time, **409** for overlap, no queue.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "UI elements" can mean public author-facing components or internal host elements; resolved: **Deck Apps** use the **VitaDeck Runtime API**, while host elements remain internal.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "`runtime` package" is too narrow for the package that also builds artifacts; resolved: use **VitaDeck SDK** for `@vitadeck/sdk`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "React dependency" could mean bundled app code or a VitaDeck-provided runtime dependency; resolved: React is a **Runtime Dependency** and Deck App projects develop against the SDK-compatible version.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "theme" can mean sample app styling or runtime styling; resolved: the shared theme is a **Runtime Theme** owned by VitaDeck.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - "clickable rect" suggests visual primitives are interactive; resolved: **Press** goes through **Button** and **Text Input**, and only `Scroll` takes scroll input.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "click" and "mouse" terms are implementation leakage; resolved: public input language is **Press**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "confirm" could mean **Deck App** **Press** or **VitaDeck Shell** confirmation; resolved: **Shell Face Input** uses Cross/Circle conventions in the Shell, while **Deck Apps** use **Press**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - "Enter" could mean **Deck App** activation or **Shell Face Input** confirm; resolved: **Host Shell Confirm Mapping** applies only while the **VitaDeck Shell** is open; in a **Deck App** Enter is Cross and presses the control with **Focus**, except during a **Text Input** edit, where it confirms the edit.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - "focus" could mean the Shell's highlighted row or the **Deck App** control Cross presses; resolved: **Focus** is the **Deck App** term, and the Shell keeps **Shell Face Input** language.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - "Backspace" could mean Shell back or a **Deck App** input; resolved: it is Circle, so back while the **VitaDeck Shell** is open and the `circle` **Pad Button** while a **Deck App** runs; during a **Text Input** edit it deletes a character.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "Surface" and "viewport" were considered for the root display component; resolved: the public component is **Screen**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "render function" suggests author-controlled bootstrapping; resolved: authors export a **Deck App Component** and VitaDeck bootstraps it.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "entry" can mean author source or generated package code; resolved: **Deck App Source Entry** is authored, **Deck App Package Entry** is generated.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "generated registration" could imply restricted author syntax; resolved: author code supports TypeScript and ES modules before SDK compilation.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - "font" could mean a raw file path, a platform-installed family, or a package-declared asset; resolved: author-provided fonts are **Deck App Fonts** declared by name in the **Deck App Package Manifest**.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - "font family" could imply CSS-style weight and style resolution; resolved: **Deck App Font** references are flat names for concrete font files.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - "font size" could mean CSS points, scaling, or theme tokens; resolved: **Font Size** is a raw pixel value in the **VitaDeck Runtime API**.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - "default font" could mean Raylib's built-in bitmap font or a bundled VitaDeck typeface; resolved: use a VitaDeck-provided sans-serif **Runtime Default Font**.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - "`default` font" could mean an app-declared font name or VitaDeck fallback; resolved: `default` is VitaDeck-reserved and selects the **Runtime Default Font**.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - "font fallback" could hide invalid packages; resolved: missing or unsupported declared **Deck App Fonts** fail package validation instead of silently falling back.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - "font loading" could mean lazy render-time loading or package startup loading; resolved: declared **Deck App Fonts** load when the **Deck App Package** starts.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - "font sizes" could imply package-declared preloaded size sets; resolved: **Deck App Fonts** render at arbitrary raw-pixel **Font Size** values for now.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - "providing fonts" could mean hand-editing the package output; resolved: authors declare **Deck App Fonts** in SDK configuration and the **VitaDeck SDK** copies them into the package.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "manifest" could mean runtime configuration or build metadata; resolved: **Deck App Manifest** is build-time metadata in the MVP.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "artifact" could mean either a complete VitaDeck runtime bundle or a portable **Deck App Package**; resolved: the package excludes the VitaDeck runtime.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "package" could mean an archive or a directory; resolved: the on-disk artifact is a **Deck App Package Directory**, while **Runtime Upload** uses a **Runtime Upload Archive** for transport.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "zip layout" could mean flat files at the archive root or a nested `.vdapp` folder; resolved: **Runtime Upload Archive** requires exactly one top-level `.vdapp` directory.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "`schemaVersion`" can be mistaken for the app release version; resolved: use **Deck App Package Schema Version** vs **Deck App Package Version**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "`version`" could mean npm package versioning or **Deck App Package Version**; resolved: **Deck App Package Version** is the `version` field in `manifest.json`, semver-shaped for VitaDeck UI, sourced from `package.json` by default and overridden by optional `vitadeck.config.json` `version`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "`outDir` could mean the final package directory or its parent; resolved: `outDir` is the parent and the **VitaDeck SDK** generates the `.vdapp` directory name.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "**Deck App Workspace** no longer means only in-repository app source; resolved: it is the JavaScript pnpm workspace for SDK, runtime, and examples.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - "selected app" is the **Active Deck App**; resolved: the **VitaDeck Shell** selects it on-device, and VitaDeck falls back to the first installed package when none is set.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - "upload" does not imply activation; resolved: Runtime Upload installs into the **Installed Deck App Library**, and activation is explicit unless no **Active Deck App** is set.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "upload install" could mean RAM-only or until reboot; resolved: published **Runtime Upload** packages persist like other **Installed Deck App Library** entries; staging alone is ephemeral.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "Vita UI" could mean a Deck App screen or VitaDeck management UI; resolved: management belongs to the **VitaDeck Shell**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - "`Start` input" is not Deck App input; resolved: it is **Start Input** (**System Input**) reserved for VitaDeck, mapped on the desktop host via **Host Start Mapping** (F1), toggling between the **Deck App** and **VitaDeck Shell**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - "cancel upload" could mean leaving the Shell entirely; resolved: **Shell Upload Cancel** stops the listener while keeping the Shell open.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - "cancel control" could imply a dedicated keyboard binding; resolved: **Shell Upload Cancel** is the normal confirm on the **Shell Upload Entry**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - "HTTP server on Vita" could imply an always-on network service; resolved: use a **Runtime Upload Listener** started from the **Shell Upload Entry** and stopped by **Shell Upload Cancel**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "upload server API" could sprawl into many routes; resolved: **Runtime Upload HTTP Contract** — **`GET /`** + Web UI assets and **`POST /upload`** only as the documented surface; **404**/**405** as above; no health endpoint initially.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "upload URL" could hide port collisions or loopback-only binds; resolved: **Runtime Upload URL** uses LAN IP and the port actually bound; default **8787** with consecutive fallback up to **10** attempts; all interfaces.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - "ports exhausted" could leave the user stuck or imply auto-retry; resolved: the Shell shows the bind error with no URL, and confirming the **Shell Upload Entry** again retries.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "Upload UI" could mean a **Deck App** flow, a **VitaDeck Shell** flow, or a browser page; resolved: **Runtime Upload** reaches the **Shell Upload Screen** from the **Shell Home Screen** via primary **Shell Upload Entry**, then uses the browser **Runtime Upload Web UI** at the **Runtime Upload URL**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - "upload finished" could mean success or failure; resolved: both leave the **Runtime Upload Listener** running; success also updates the **Installed Deck App Library** list.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "secure upload" could imply authenticated clients; resolved: initial **Runtime Upload** is LAN-trusted, with optional future **Upload Pairing**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "trusted LAN" could imply unlimited resource use; resolved: still enforce **Runtime Upload Limits** and fail closed without partial installs.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "atomic install" could imply heavy transactional machinery; resolved: use **Runtime Upload Staging** plus a swap/publish step only when it stays simple; never surface invalid packages as installed.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "delete app" could include deleting the running **Deck App**; resolved: disallow **Installed Deck App Removal** for the **Active Deck App**.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "replace" could sound like **Installed Deck App Removal**; resolved: **Runtime Upload Replacement** overwrites package contents and may restart the active session, but does not remove the active selection.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "restart" could mean hot reload versus a full context reset; resolved: use **Deck App Runtime Restart** for a fresh JavaScript context.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "globals available in Deck App code" can mean ordinary JS host conveniences or VitaDeck native bridge entry points; resolved: the author-facing surface is the **VitaDeck Runtime API** plus a small typed host subset for normal patterns, not native bridge calls.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - "app list order" could mean install order, recent use, or arbitrary; resolved: **Shell Home Screen** sorts by manifest **`name`** (case-insensitive), tie-break **Deck App Package Name**.
